abstract: PubChem (https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov) is a public chemical information resource that serves scientific communities across various domains, as well as the general public. Over the past 2 years, substantial changes have been made to PubChem. The addition of over 100 new data sources has broadened its data coverage. A new data collection, RefChem, containing chemical records compiled by the PubChem team from authoritative and curated sources, was introduced to improve annotation mapping and disambiguation and to provide better access to information on substances with non-discrete structures. The Quick Search supports general exploration across multiple data collections, while the Advanced Search provides more structured, fielded search options for individual collections. The new Search History page enables users to formulate complex queries using Boolean operators. Major updates were also made to the Classification Browser and Co-occurrence Panels. Updates to PubChemRDF improved its search performance and interoperability. Practical guidance was provided for its efficient use in cloud environments. This article provides an overview of the latest updates to PubChem.
